report:
LogMiner session stopped due to an error frequently in prod system and the connector scn doesn't move forward post that

CONNECTOR / PLATFORM VERSIONS
Debezium version : 3.2.6Kafka Connect client version : 3.9.1Oracle JDBC driver version : 19.30.0.0.0Oracle Database version : Oracle Database 19c Enterprise EditionRelease 19.0.0.0.0 - ProductionConnector framework : Debezium (Kafka Connect source/sink connectors)
Oracle Source connector class : io.debezium.connector.oracle.OracleConnector
MongoDB Source connector class : io.debezium.connector.mongodb.MongoDbConnector
ISSUE OBSERVED
Recurring error on the Oracle Source connector (LogMiner-based CDC):
"LogMiner session stopped due to an error."
(io.debezium.connector.oracle.logminer.AbstractLogMinerStreamingChangeEventSource)
Frequency: Occurring approximately every [4-5](
) hour on average, though theinterval is inconsistent - on some days it does not occur at all, andon other days it recurs multiple times within a few hours.
Impact / current workaround:
When the LogMiner session stops, the connector task fails and iscurrently being rotated (restarted as a new connector taskinstance, e.g. prod-v3 -> prod-v4 -> prod-v5 -> ... -> prod-v17,observed incrementing across the review window).
On restart, the previous committed offset is patched/re-applied sothat CDC processing can continue from where it left off, avoidinga full re-snapshot.
This keeps the pipeline running but is a manual/operationalmitigation, not a permanent fix - the underlying LogMiner sessioninstability has not been root-caused yet.
Secondary symptom observed:
There have also been cases where the connector reports the messageas successfully processed/produced (i.e. it shows up as deliveredin DLQ/produced-message tracking), but the message still does notarrive at the expected downstream consumer/sink - i.e. anintermittent message drop despite an apparently successful publishacknowledgement on the source side.
Please help as we are very close to PROD deployment

evidence.quote: As to the exception in production, that's not Debezium-specific, that's that you have network connectivity or stability issues.

notes: 'LogMiner session stopped' is SQLRecoverableException Connection reset during long mining queries; cause is network/idle timeout. Later ORA-00310 left open pending DEBUG logs.
